server_file.label: Connection: Home Assistant server file
server_file.description: File containing the Home Assistant base URL. This keeps the URL outside the declarative plugin config.

token_file.label: Connection: Home Assistant token file
token_file.description: File containing a long-lived Home Assistant token. It is read only at runtime and never stored by the plugin.

allow_insecure_tls.label: Connection: Allow insecure TLS
allow_insecure_tls.description: Skip HTTPS certificate verification. Use only for a trusted Home Assistant with a self-signed certificate.

refresh_interval.label: Connection: Refresh interval (seconds)
refresh_interval.description: How often to re-fetch the state of your configured entities.

browser_page_size.label: Advanced: Browser page size
browser_page_size.description: How many entities the "Add entity" browser fetches per page/Load-more click. Lower this if browsing still feels slow on a very large Home Assistant instance; there is normally no need to touch it.

bar_display_mode.label: Bar: Display mode
bar_display_mode.description: Entities shows one icon per configured entity, tinted by state. Single icon collapses the whole widget to one fixed glyph instead -- for a bar slot that doesn't grow, shrink or recolor as entities are added or change state.

bar_icon.label: Bar: Single icon glyph
bar_icon.description: Overrides the real Home Assistant logo shown when Bar: Display mode is set to Single icon. Leave as smart-home for the logo; any other Tabler icon name (e.g. home, bulb) switches to that plain glyph instead.

panel_dashboard_path.label: Panel: Home Assistant link path
panel_dashboard_path.description: Relative path opened by the panel's Open Home Assistant button, appended to the server URL. For example: /lovelace/0.

panel_hide_edit_button.label: Panel: Hide edit button
panel_hide_edit_button.description: Hide the Edit button and prevent layout changes from the panel. Declarative YAML layouts continue to work.

panel_show_search.label: Panel: Show entity search
panel_show_search.description: Show an optional search bar in the main entity view. Matching sections expand automatically.

panel_search_position.label: Panel: Entity search position
panel_search_position.description: Choose where the optional entity search bar appears. At the bottom, it remains visible while the entity list scrolls.

bar_spacing.label: Bar: Spacing
bar_spacing.description: Gap between entity icons in the bar.
